# Copilot instructions for LearnPlayWright3X

Repository: LearnPlayWright3X
GitHub remote: https://github.com/rajr96/LearnPlayWright3X.git

When the user says "go go go" or makes a similar request to update documentation and publish the work:

1. Update the parent README.md with a clear summary of the JavaScript exercises that have been completed in this repository.
2. Include chapter-by-chapter details, file names, short descriptions, and practical examples where appropriate.
3. Keep the README aligned with the files currently present in the workspace.
4. Add all relevant files to the Git working tree.
5. Review the changes and verify the final diff before committing.
6. Commit all changes with a message such as "docs: update README with completed exercises".
7. Push the commit to the remote repository branch.
8. Report the commit hash and push result to the user.

Prefer concise, accurate documentation and avoid inventing exercises that are not present in the repository.

GitHub workflow notes:
- Use git status to review pending changes before committing.
- Use git add . for staging all updates when appropriate.
- Use git push origin master to publish changes to GitHub.
